title: Drake Reacts to Serena Williams’ Super Bowl Cameo Amid Kendrick Lamar Feud
htmlContent:
The internet again talks about Drake, this time after Serena Williams appeared during Kendrick Lamar's Super Bowl LIX performance. Instead of directly addressing Lamar, the Toronto rapper responded subtly yet cryptically, causing confusion and backlash from fans.

Drake’s Burner Account Post Raises Eyebrows

On Wednesday (February). Drake shared a photo of himself posing with a woman on his alleged burner Instagram account, @plottttwisttttt, that seems randomly chosen. Jill Smoller, Serena Williams' longtime agent, was recognized by fans upon closer inspection. The Getty Images' database was further analyzed, and it was found that the picture dates back to 2015. At the time, Drake attended a tennis event in support of Williams. He is seen shaking hands with Smoller, interacting with Venus Williams, and watching the match with his close friend OVO Chubbs in photos taken that day. The outfit he wore in the image with Smoller matches the one he wore in other pictures from the event, which confirms its origin.

Fans Question Drake’s Intentions

Drake's choice to mention Serena Williams' agent caused immediate reactions online instead of discussing Kendrick Lamar's name drop. Many fans perceived the move as a deflector, with some questioning why he was indirectly responding to Williams instead of Kendrick. Social media users had a great deal to say.
  • “A grown man said your name on a global stage but you got a rebuttal for the woman who was dancing?”
  • “Kendrick has been dog-walking Drake since last year, and this is his response?”
  • “Drake is so unbothered that he posted a nearly 10-year-old picture. Makes sense.”
Drake's fans defended him, arguing that the post wasn't meant to be taken seriously. They thought the rapper was playing around with the situation, refusing to respond to Lamar's diss directly.

Drake and Serena Williams: A Complicated History

For quite some time now, it has been rumored that Drake and Serena Williams had a romantic past. The rapper's frequent curtsied appearances during her matches led to speculation in 2011. The two were seen together on multiple occasions, though neither publicly confirmed their relationship.

Although their rumored romance seemed to end by 2015, Drake's lyrics over the years have still hinted at their past involvement. His 2022 song 'Middle of the Ocean' was notable for a pointed reference to Williams and her husband, Alexis Ohanian, who were referred to as a 'groupie'.

Williams responded later with a dismissive response and showed no interest in engaging in any drama with her ex.

Where Does Drake Stand in the Kendrick Lamar Feud?

Drake's response to Kendrick Lamar's name-drop at the Super Bowl has yet to be directly responded to by fans, even though they continue to analyze every move he makes. His Instagram post, whether it was a subliminal jab or a nostalgic throwback, has sparked more debate about his approach to the continuing tensions with Lamar. All eyes are on Drake as speculation continues to surface to see if he will finally respond in a more definitive manner.
